question: The older title styles are toned down. Do they look calm and presentable now?
context: Reel, before on the left, after on the right: queue/audits/2026-10-18-calm-more-styles-reel.mp4 (51 s, all twelve). Before and after frames: queue/audits/2026-10-18-calm-more-styles-before-after-contact.png. Per title audit: queue/audits/2026-10-18-calm-more-styles-audit.md.

options.label: Ship as toned down
options.summary: All twelve older styles stay under More Styles as you see them in the reel: slow, faint backgrounds, one gentle move per part, no springs or 3D turns, the card leaving with a fade.
pros: Backgrounds move a quarter to a ninth as much as before
Each style still looks like itself
cons: Kinetic Bold keeps its bright blue, Gradient Glow its coloured words, Tech Terminal its moving grid
options.mitigation: Speed, strength and colours stay tunable per title in the panel.

options.label: Ship, but still busy: rework the ones I name
options.summary: Say which styles still look busy and what bothers you (the blue, the specks, the aurora streaks, the grid); those get calmed further and the rest ship as they are.
pros: Nothing busy is left on the shelf
cons: Needs your notes on which ones
options.mitigation: React straight on the audit lines for the styles you mean.

options.label: Make every background hold still
options.summary: Go all the way to the new ten: every older style stands on a still picture of its look, and only its words move.
pros: As calm as the new title pages
cons: The older styles lose what set them apart from the new ten
options.mitigation: A person can still turn a look back on, with its Speed, from the panel.
